760910101.text: A flying fae! My notes... The Fatui took my precious notes! Could you help me get them back?

760910102.text: Well, Paimon's not really a fae... but something like this should be a piece of cake! Still, what do the Fatui want with some kid's notes?

760910103.text: Maybe they're afraid I'll show them to the world... If you help me get them back, I'll let you in on their secrets.

760910105.text: But we can talk about that later. Right now, please help me get my <color=#00E1FFFF>notes</color> back. <color=#00E1FFFF>Some pages might've fallen out</color> from my notebook... They should be over there, where the Fatui are.

760910401.text: I'll leave the notes to you. There might still be some scattered pages... over there, where the Fatui are.

760910601.text: Anyway, thanks a lot! See you!

760910702.text: Let me see... Yup! These are the ones. Thank you so much! There's a lot of evidence about the Fatui's crimes in here.

760910704.text: Just look at all those facilities they built on Paha Isle, and the mechanical devices they brought in... That place used to be home to so many animals.

760910705.text: I just got back from Maroon Basin. It must be because of the Fatui's machines, all the jellyfish there are barely hanging on... I have to let everyone know about this.

760910709.text: Oh, and if you tell anyone else about this, make sure to say it was me, Semyon, who told you. After all, it's going to take a while before I can write it all up and publish it in the paper...

760910710.text: I'll leave these notes with you for now. I need to hurry back and put everything else I've learned in order. I need to turn all this into an article.

760910701.text: Anyway, thanks a lot! See you!

760910203.text: You hand over the notebook and the pages you found...

760910204.text: Let me see... Yup! These are the ones. Thank you so much! There's a lot of evidence about the Fatui's crimes in here.

760910206.text: Just look at all those facilities they built on Paha Isle, and the mechanical devices they brought in... That place used to be home to so many animals.

760910207.text: I just got back from Maroon Basin. It must be because of the Fatui's machines, all the jellyfish there are barely hanging on... I have to let everyone know about this.

760910208.text: Huh? You mean Valberry Jelly and the others? But...

760910209.text: You tell him what happened at Maroon Basin...

760910210.text: So it's already too late... Nevertheless, this needs to be reported!
